releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.37:
- Single Clean KDS Bump Bar: Removed redundant header legend in cocina.html and kds.html, displaying a single dedicated instructions banner.
- 20-Order KDS Grid View: Standardized Kitchen and Station KDS grid to 5 columns x 4 rows (20 orders per screen) with smooth pagination.
- Full 1-20 Bump Keypad Selection: Keypad selection 1-20 and direct buffer bump for kitchen stations.
- Enhanced Monochrome Thermal Logo Contrast: Calibrated thermal raster threshold (80 luminance) for sharp, clear business logo prints without dark background dithering.
- 100% Quality Standard: Passed all pre-flight simulator checks and integrity audits with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
